title: Part 11
content_zh: How do I know that loving life is not a delusion? How do I know that hating death is not like a young man who has lost his way and does not know the way home? Lady Li was captured by the army of Jin. At first, her tears soaked her collar. But when she arrived at the palace and shared the king's bed and ate the meat of grain-fed animals, she wondered why she had ever wept.
